entries.english: Relations with the Rüdt family. Term: 1573, 1603–1615. Contents: (1) disputes between Philipp Jakob von Rosenberg and Stefan Rüdt von Bödigheim over the noval tithe at Sindolsheim; (2) the proposed sale of their village of Rüdenau and two farms at Kleinheubach; (3) further disputes and correspondence concerning rights and revenues.
